headline: UPDATE (The Sanctions Ledger) -- US Amb to the UN Mike Waltz (FT interview)
dek: Waltz told the FT the naval blockade of Iran could be maintained for the 'foreseeable future', and that the so-called maximum pressure campaign is 'only tightening', adding that the Iranian government is continuing to 'suffer under the pressure.'
sources: US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz, interview with the Financial Times, via Al Jazeera liveblog 18:30 GMT Oct 23
fault_line: A blockade with no end date vs a country that says its reserves will outlast Trump's term — who blinks first?
